CRT-637.summary: Default Price Tolerance and Max Order Size for FX_SPOT
CRT-637.description:
*Business Context*

There should be a possibility to set minimum price tolerance and max order size for FX_Spot instruments.

*Acceptance Criteria* 

*Max order size value on UI*

Given the User wants to buy/sell FX Spot instrument
When the User tries to enter a value more than max tradable amount
Then the User is not able to select it in the picker 
And validation error is displayed for manual input.

*'FX Settings' widget*
Given the User is in webbroker
When the User opens 'User and Risk Management' menu
Then the User sees 'FX Settings' in the list of widgets.

_FX Spot Suffix Section in the 'FX Settings' widget_
Given the User has opened the widget 'FX Settings'
And the User has specified configuration level  
When the User types the text in the 'Enter text' field
Then the User is able to save it by clicking the button.

_Min Tolerance/Max order size Sections in the 'FX Settings' widget_
Given the User has opened the widget 'FX Settings'
When the User specifies configuration level  
And the User uploads a file
And validation is passed successfully
Then the tolerance/max order size values for FX_Spot instruments listed in the file are updated for the selected accounts/account groups.

Given the User has opened the widget 'FX Settings'
When the User selects the same configuration level  
And the User clicks to export a file
Then the file is downloaded.

Given the User has opened the widget 'FX Settings'
When the User selects the same configuration level  
And the User hovers the symbol hint
Then the full list of symbols and values is displayed.

Given the User specifies configuration level  
And the tolerance/max order size values are not defined for it
When the User hovers/clicks to export a file
Then the message 'List is empty' is displayed.

CRT-669.description:
h2. Requirements:
 * Introduce max liquidation qty on instrument level for CFD/CFD_FOREX/CFD_STOCK instruments: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1891] 
 * Value should be available for update via dxMC
 * Split positions in chunks when max liquidation qty is defined: [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1785] 

By default:
 * all instruments with CFD_FOREX_OTC subtype should have max liquidation qty = 200
 * all instruments with CFD_FOREX_DMA subtype should have max liquidation qty = 20 000 000
 * all instruments on CFD/CFD_STOCKS shouldn't have any value and shouldn't be liquidated in chunks by default

{color:#ff0000}(!) Functionality should be ported to 270 branch{color}
h2. Scenario:
 # Create position with qty > max liquidation qty of the instrument (CFD Forex), e.g. 500. There shouldn't be any restriction to send an order > max liquidation qty
 # Increase margin or withdraw cash to make Margin Utilization metric > 100% during trading hours.
 # Liquidation should start and send 2 orders with qty 200 and 1 order with qty 100.
 # Liquidation should complete only after all orders are completed

Repeat the test for non-trading hours: liquidation should wait for trading hours and send same 3 orders. Set one of the orders to be rejected max number of rejections according to config. The other 2 orders should be completed, one remain rejected (according to step 4 in [https://confluence.in.devexperts.com/requirements/CT/CRT-1126] ) -> liquidation status should become in review.

 

See the cause of these requirements in the attached email.
